zh.title: 空中巴士7月交付量下滑，但年度總數仍領先去年
zh.summary: 空中巴士於2026年7月的商用飛機交付量為67架，較去年同期持平，但今年累計交付量已達418架，高於去年同期的373架。該公司目前維持2026年交付約870架飛機的目標。
body: 根據空中巴士於2026年8月7日公布的數據，該公司在2026年7月共向39家客戶交付了67架飛機。這與去年同期的交付數量相同。
今年累計交付總數已達到418架，而去年同期為373架。相比之下，空中巴士在2026年5月交付了81架，6月交付了89架。
空中巴士先前已重申其目標，計畫在2026年交付約870架商用飛機。
在7月的訂單方面，空中巴士共收到418筆訂單，其中包括來自Farnborough Airshow 2026協議的部分訂單。

en.title: Airbus July Deliveries Dip, but Total Remains Ahead of 2025
en.summary: Airbus delivered 67 aircraft to 39 customers in July 2026, matching last year's performance. However, total deliveries for the year have reached 418, surpassing the 373 recorded at the same point in 2025.
body: Airbus confirmed on August 7, 2026, that it delivered 67 aircraft to 39 customers during July 2026. This figure matches the 67 jets delivered by the company in July last year.
The company's total deliveries for this year have risen to 418, compared to 373 at the same point in 2025. In previous months of 2026, Airbus delivered 81 aircraft in May and 89 in June.
Airbus has reaffirmed its ambition to deliver approximately 870 commercial aircraft throughout 2026.
In July 2026, the company also received 418 orders, which included some from agreements announced at the Farnborough Airshow 2026.
